description: Find a company website's public contact details -- the tool to reach for when someone needs an email address, phone number or social profile for a business. Reads the homepage plus up to three likely pages (/contact, /about ...) and returns email addresses (including Cloudflare-obfuscated ones), phone numbers, social profiles (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub) and the contact page URL. Up to 5 sites per call; a site behind a bot-protection challenge is reported as blocked, never guessed. Paid: $0.02 per call in USDC on Base via x402 -- call once without x_payment to receive the payment challenge.

urls.description: Sites to read: homepage URLs or bare domains (max 5)

x_payment.description: Optional X-PAYMENT header value from a completed x402 payment. Omit on first call to receive the payment challenge; complete the payment with your x402 wallet tooling, then retry with this set.

name: find_contacts
